ACTAM · LESSON 04 · LISTENING LAB

Name that groove.

Eight famous drum parts, rebuilt from patterns of hits and rests with our lesson04 kit. Listen and guess the song. Then open the solution: a link to the original recording and the Python code that generates the pattern.

Every clip exists in two versions. Lesson 04 kit uses only the notebook’s instruments. Plus kit adds sine drums, filtered noise, dynamics and a small room. Start at a low volume; nothing plays automatically. Before you reveal the song, try to write its pattern yourself.

Groove 01

Intro

With shaker

Solution 1 · the song

The Ronettes — Be My Baby (1963)

Drums: Hal Blaine. The most famous intro in pop: boom, ba-boom, CRACK.

Listen to the original on YouTube ↗

Solution 2 · the code (lesson 04 kit) 
from random import seed
from drumkit import *

# ── PATTERN ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
BPM = 129
#          1 e & a 2 e & a 3 e & a 4 e & a
KICK   = "x.....x.x......."
SNARE  = "............x..."
SHAKER = "x.x.x.x.x.x.x.x."
# ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────


def boom(sample_rate=SR):
    return kick(duration=0.6, start_hz=120, end_hz=50, amp_tau=0.15,
                sample_rate=sample_rate)


def crack(sample_rate=SR):
    return snare(duration=0.8, noise_gain=1.0, sample_rate=sample_rate)


def shaker(sample_rate=SR):
    return closed_hat(duration=0.08, tau=0.03, amplitude=0.06,
                      sample_rate=sample_rate)


def intro(bars=2, with_shaker=False):
    s = round(60 / BPM / 4 * SR)
    tracks = [
        ring_track(KICK * bars, boom, s),
        ring_track(SNARE * bars, crack, s),
    ]
    if with_shaker:
        tracks.append(ring_track(SHAKER * bars, shaker, s))
    return render_timed_tracks(tracks)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    seed(2026)
    save_wav("renders/be_my_baby_1_intro.wav", intro(bars=2) * 2)
    save_wav("renders/be_my_baby_2_shaker.wav", intro(bars=4, with_shaker=True))
Solution 3 · the code (plus kit) 
from random import seed
from drumkit_plus import *

# ── PATTERN ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
BPM = 129
STEP = 60 / BPM / 4
#          1 e & a 2 e & a 3 e & a 4 e & a
KICK   = "9.....7.9......."
SNARE  = "............9..."
SHAKER = "6.4.6.4.6.4.6.4."
# ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────


def boom(sample_rate=SR):
    return tone_drum(duration=0.8, start_hz=145, end_hz=100, pitch_tau=0.03,
                     amp_tau=0.12, amplitude=0.2, drive=5, click=0.15,
                     click_tau=0.006,
                     sample_rate=sample_rate)


def crack(sample_rate=SR):
    body = tone_drum(duration=0.6, start_hz=380, end_hz=330, amp_tau=0.07,
                     amplitude=0.3, drive=7, sample_rate=sample_rate)
    wires = noise_drum(duration=0.6, tau=0.12, low_hz=1500, high_hz=8000,
                       amplitude=0.8, sample_rate=sample_rate)
    return mix_tracks([body, wires])


def shaker(sample_rate=SR):
    return noise_drum(duration=0.1, tau=0.03, low_hz=4000, high_hz=12000,
                      amplitude=0.15, sample_rate=sample_rate)


def wall_of_sound(wave):
    return room(wave, rt60=2.0, wet=0.5, tone_hz=5000)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    seed(2026)
    save_wav("renders/be_my_baby_1_intro.wav", wall_of_sound(render_hit_tracks([
        (KICK * 4, boom, STEP),
        (SNARE * 4, crack, STEP),
    ])))
    save_wav("renders/be_my_baby_2_shaker.wav", wall_of_sound(render_hit_tracks([
        (KICK * 4, boom, STEP),
        (SNARE * 4, crack, STEP),
        (SHAKER * 4, shaker, STEP),
    ])))

from random import seed
from drumkit_plus import *

# ── PATTERN ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
BPM = 117
STEP = 60 / BPM / 4
BARS = 8
#         1 e & a 2 e & a 3 e & a 4 e & a
KICK   = "9.......9......."
SNARE  = "....9.......9..."
HAT    = "8.5.8.6.8.6.7.5."
# ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────


def linn_kick(sample_rate=SR):
    return tone_drum(duration=0.3, start_hz=120, end_hz=48, pitch_tau=0.015,
                     amp_tau=0.035, amplitude=0.35, drive=5, click=0.3,
                     click_tau=0.004,
                     sample_rate=sample_rate)


def linn_snare(sample_rate=SR):
    body = tone_drum(duration=0.25, start_hz=220, end_hz=170, amp_tau=0.035,
                     amplitude=0.3, drive=6, sample_rate=sample_rate)
    wires = noise_drum(duration=0.25, tau=0.045, low_hz=2000, high_hz=10000,
                       amplitude=0.5, sample_rate=sample_rate)
    return mix_tracks([body, wires])


def linn_hat(sample_rate=SR):
    return noise_drum(duration=0.15, tau=0.025, low_hz=7000,
                      amplitude=0.3, sample_rate=sample_rate)


INTRO = [
    (KICK * BARS, linn_kick, STEP),
    (SNARE * BARS, linn_snare, STEP),

]

Solution 2 · the code (lesson 04 kit) 
from random import seed
from drumkit import *

# ── PATTERN ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
BPM = 130
STEP = 60 / BPM / 4
#            1 e & a 2 e & a 3 e & a 4 e & a
ROLL_BAR  = "x...x...xxxxxxxx"
PLAIN_BAR = "x...x...x...x..."
KICK      = ROLL_BAR + PLAIN_BAR          # two-bar cycle
OFFBEATS  = "..x...x...x...x." * 2
# ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────


def dmx_kick(sample_rate=SR):
    return kick(duration=0.12, start_hz=200, end_hz=55, amp_tau=0.04,
                sample_rate=sample_rate)


def intro():
    return render_tracks([(KICK, dmx_kick, STEP)]) * 2


def with_hats():
    return render_tracks([
        (KICK, dmx_kick, STEP),
        (OFFBEATS, open_hat, STEP),
    ]) * 2


if __name__ == "__main__":
    seed(2026)
    save_wav("renders/blue_monday_1_intro.wav", intro())
    save_wav("renders/blue_monday_2_hats.wav", with_hats())

from random import seed
from drumkit import *

# ── PATTERN ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

STEP = 60 / BPM / 4
#            1 e & a 2 e & a 3 e & a 4 e & a
KICK     = "x.......x......."
SNARE    = "....x.......x..."
HAT_A    = "xxx.x.xx..x.x.x."
HAT_B    = "x.xxx.x.x.x.x.x."
# first bar: the pickup with a double hit before beat 3
PICK_K   = "x.....x.x...x..."
PICK_S   = "....x.xx....x..."
# ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

GROOVE = 3 * (HAT_A + HAT_B)

INTRO = [
    (PICK_K + KICK * 6, kick, STEP),
    (PICK_S + SNARE * 6, snare, STEP),
    ("x...x.x.x.x.x.x." + GROOVE, closed_hat, STEP),
]

if __name__ == "__main__":
    seed(2026)
    save_wav("renders/superstition_1_intro.wav", render_tracks(INTRO))

Solution 1 · the song

Led Zeppelin — When the Levee Breaks (1971)

Drums: John Bonham, recorded in the stairwell of Headley Grange.

Listen to the original on YouTube ↗

Solution 2 · the code (lesson 04 kit) 
from random import seed
from drumkit import *

# ── PATTERN ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
BPM = 71
#          1 e & a 2 e & a 3 e & a 4 e & a
KICK   = "x......x..x....."
SNARE  = "....x.......x..."
HAT    = "x...x...x...x..."     # soft, on the beats
HAT_UP = "..x...x...x...x."     # louder, on the "&"
# ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────


def big_kick(sample_rate=SR):
    return kick(duration=0.9, start_hz=110, end_hz=38,
                pitch_tau=0.04, amp_tau=0.25, amplitude=0.25,
                sample_rate=sample_rate)


def big_snare(sample_rate=SR):
    return snare(duration=0.7, amplitude=0.15, noise_gain=0.9,
                 sample_rate=sample_rate)


def soft_hat(sample_rate=SR):
    return closed_hat(amplitude=0.07, sample_rate=sample_rate)


def crash(sample_rate=SR):
    return open_hat(duration=3.0, tau=0.7, amplitude=0.12,
                    sample_rate=sample_rate)


def intro():
    s = round(60 / BPM / 4 * SR)
    bars = 4
    return render_timed_tracks([
        ring_track(KICK * bars, big_kick, s),
        ring_track(SNARE * bars, big_snare, s),
        ring_track(HAT * bars, soft_hat, s),
        ring_track(HAT_UP * bars, closed_hat, s),
    ])


def the_break():
    s = round(60 / 74 / 4 * SR)         # a little faster here
    quarters = "x...x...x...x..."
    silence = "." * 32
    reentry = "x.......x.......x.....x.....x..."   # 1, 3, then every 1½ beats
    return render_timed_tracks([
        ring_track(KICK + quarters + silence + reentry + "..x....x..x....." + KICK, big_kick, s),
        ring_track(SNARE + quarters + silence + "." * 32 + SNARE + SNARE, big_snare, s),
        ring_track("." * 16 + quarters + silence + reentry + "." * 32, crash, s),
        ring_track("x.x." * 4 + "." * 16 + silence + "." * 32 + "x.x." * 8, closed_hat, s),
    ])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    seed(2026)
    save_wav("renders/levee_breaks_1_intro.wav", intro())
    save_wav("renders/levee_breaks_2_break.wav", the_break())
Solution 3 · the code (plus kit) 
from random import seed
from drumkit_plus import *

# ── PATTERN ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
BPM = 71
STEP = 60 / BPM / 4
#         1 e & a 2 e & a 3 e & a 4 e & a      levels: . 1..9, x=5, X=9
KICK   = "9......8..9....."
SNARE  = "....9.......9..."
HAT    = "4.8.4.8.4.8.4.8."
# ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────


def big_kick(sample_rate=SR):
    return tone_drum(duration=1.0, start_hz=160, end_hz=90, pitch_tau=0.03,
                     amp_tau=0.12, amplitude=0.3, drive=3, click=0.25,
                     click_tau=0.01,
                     sample_rate=sample_rate)


def big_snare(sample_rate=SR):
    body = tone_drum(duration=0.5, start_hz=260, end_hz=215, amp_tau=0.06,
                     amplitude=0.3, drive=4, sample_rate=sample_rate)
    wires = noise_drum(duration=0.5, tau=0.09, low_hz=1500, high_hz=9000,
                       amplitude=0.6, sample_rate=sample_rate)
    return mix_tracks([body, wires])


def hat(sample_rate=SR):
    return noise_drum(duration=0.2, tau=0.035, low_hz=5000,
                      amplitude=0.3, sample_rate=sample_rate)


def crash(sample_rate=SR):
    return noise_drum(duration=3.0, tau=0.8, low_hz=3000, high_hz=12000,
                      amplitude=0.15, sample_rate=sample_rate)


def stairwell(wave):
    return room(wave, rt60=1.8, wet=0.45, tone_hz=5000)


def intro(bars=4):
    return stairwell(render_hit_tracks([
        (KICK * bars, big_kick, STEP),
        (SNARE * bars, big_snare, STEP),
        (HAT * bars, hat, STEP),
    ]))


def the_break():
    step = 60 / 74 / 4
    quarters = "7...7...7...7..."   # kick, snare and crash together: keep headroom
    silence = "." * 32
    reentry = "7.......7.......7.....7.....7..."
    return stairwell(render_hit_tracks([
        (KICK + quarters + silence + reentry + "..9....8..9....." + KICK, big_kick, step),
        (SNARE + quarters + silence + "." * 32 + SNARE + SNARE, big_snare, step),
        ("." * 16 + quarters + silence + reentry + "." * 32, crash, step),
        (HAT + "." * 16 + silence + "." * 32 + HAT * 2, hat, step),
    ]))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    seed(2026)
    save_wav("renders/levee_breaks_1_intro.wav", intro())
    save_wav("renders/levee_breaks_2_break.wav", the_break())

from random import seed
from drumkit_plus import *

# ── PATTERN ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
BPM = 126
STEP = 60 / BPM / 4
#        1 e & a 2 e & a 3 e & a 4 e & a | 1 e & a 2 e & a 3 e & a 4 e & a
KICK  = "9.........9....." + "9...6.....9....."
SNARE = "............8..." + "............8..."
TOM   = "..............7." + "..............7."
HAT   = "5...5.5...5....." + "5.........5....."
# ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────


def lm1_kick(sample_rate=SR):
    return tone_drum(duration=0.4, start_hz=190, end_hz=62, pitch_tau=0.015,
                     amp_tau=0.065, amplitude=0.4, drive=3, click=0.12,
                     click_tau=0.005,
                     sample_rate=sample_rate)


def lm1_snare(sample_rate=SR):
    body = tone_drum(duration=0.4, start_hz=180, end_hz=125, amp_tau=0.06,
                     amplitude=0.25, drive=4, sample_rate=sample_rate)
    wires = noise_drum(duration=0.4, tau=0.08, low_hz=800, high_hz=6000,
                       amplitude=0.6, sample_rate=sample_rate)
    return mix_tracks([body, wires])


def lm1_tom(sample_rate=SR):
    return tone_drum(duration=0.4, start_hz=300, end_hz=200, pitch_tau=0.03,
                     amp_tau=0.08, amplitude=0.25, drive=3, sample_rate=sample_rate)


def lm1_hat(sample_rate=SR):
    return noise_drum(duration=0.1, tau=0.02, low_hz=5000, high_hz=9000,
                      amplitude=0.06, sample_rate=sample_rate)


BARS = 4  # the pattern above is already two bars long: 8 bars in all
INTRO = [
    (KICK * BARS, lm1_kick, STEP),
    (SNARE * BARS, lm1_snare, STEP),
    (TOM * BARS, lm1_tom, STEP),
    (HAT * BARS, lm1_hat, STEP),
]

if __name__ == "__main__":
    seed(2026)
    save_wav("renders/when_doves_cry_1_intro.wav",
             room(render_hit_tracks(INTRO), rt60=1.2, wet=0.35))

STEP = 60 / BPM / 3
#        1 . . 2 . . 3 . . 4 . . | 1 . . 2 . . 3 . . 4 . .
KICK  = "x....x...x.." + "..x.....x..x"
SNARE = "......x....." + "......x....."   # backbeat on 3
EXTRA = ".....x......" + "..x........."   # accented notes
GHOST = ".x..x......x" + ".x..x.....x."   # very soft
HAT   = "x.xx.xx.xx.x" + "x.xx.xx.xx.x"
# ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────


def ghost_snare(sample_rate=SR):
    return snare(duration=0.08, amplitude=0.04, noise_gain=0.8,
                 sample_rate=sample_rate)


def soft_hat(sample_rate=SR):
    return closed_hat(amplitude=0.08, sample_rate=sample_rate)


SHUFFLE = [
    (KICK, kick, STEP),
    (SNARE, snare, STEP),
    (EXTRA, snare, STEP),
    (GHOST, ghost_snare, STEP),
    (HAT, soft_hat, STEP),
]

if __name__ == "__main__":
    seed(2026)
    save_wav("renders/rosanna_1_shuffle.wav", render_tracks(SHUFFLE) * 4)
Solution 3 · the code (plus kit) 
from random import seed
from drumkit_plus import *

# ── PATTERN ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
BPM = 172
STEP = 60 / BPM / 3
#        1 . . 2 . . 3 . . 4 . . | 1 . . 2 . . 3 . . 4 . .
KICK  = "9....7...8.." + "..8.....7..6"
SNARE = ".2..2.9...2." + ".2.72.9...2."
HAT   = "7.47.47.47.4" + "7.47.47.47.4"
# ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────


def jeff_kick(sample_rate=SR):
    return tone_drum(duration=0.4, start_hz=130, end_hz=55, pitch_tau=0.015,
                     amp_tau=0.06, amplitude=0.45, drive=2, click=0.08,
                     sample_rate=sample_rate)


def jeff_snare(sample_rate=SR):
    body = tone_drum(duration=0.3, start_hz=260, end_hz=200, amp_tau=0.04,
                     amplitude=0.22, drive=2, sample_rate=sample_rate)
    wires = noise_drum(duration=0.3, tau=0.06, low_hz=1800, high_hz=9000,
                       amplitude=0.35, sample_rate=sample_rate)
    return mix_tracks([body, wires])


def jeff_hat(sample_rate=SR):
    return noise_drum(duration=0.12, tau=0.022, low_hz=6500,
                      amplitude=0.2, sample_rate=sample_rate)


SHUFFLE = [
    (KICK * 4, jeff_kick, STEP),
    (SNARE * 4, jeff_snare, STEP),
    (HAT * 4, jeff_hat, STEP),
]

if __name__ == "__main__":
    seed(2026)
    save_wav("renders/rosanna_1_shuffle.wav",
             room(render_hit_tracks(SHUFFLE), rt60=0.6, wet=0.15))
